source: Current raw Taxon strings from three QZA taxonomies and integer ASV counts, via read-only load_dataset
rule: Per model: keep explicit domain Bacteria, then exclude the union of ASVs with a rank-prefixed token whose entire trimmed value lower() equals mitochondria or chloroplast at ANY rank. No substring or related-taxon inference.

reproduction_python:
"""Independent exact-token organelle audit; no scientific input writes."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import re
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/elizavetamenshchikova/YSDA/AI/project_bacteria')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src'))
from taxonomy_compare_io import load_dataset, MODELS, sha256

OUT = ROOT / 'results/taxonomy_barplots/preflight_20261118'
JSON_OUT = OUT / 'organelle_audit.json'
TSV_OUT = OUT / 'organelle_by_sample.tsv'
assert not JSON_OUT.exists() and not TSV_OUT.exists(), 'Use new output names for a rerun'
prior_audit = json.loads((OUT / 'domain_audit.json').read_text())
source_paths = list(prior_audit['sources_before']) + [
    'results/taxonomy_barplots/preflight_20261118/domain_audit.json',
    'results/taxonomy_barplots/preflight_20261118/domain_by_sample.tsv']
before = {p: sha256(ROOT / p) for p in source_paths}
assert all(before[p] == h == prior_audit['sources_after'][p]
           for p, h in prior_audit['sources_before'].items())
dataset, issues = load_dataset(ROOT)
assert not issues, issues
with (OUT / 'domain_by_sample.tsv').open() as stream:
    old = {row['sample_id']: row for row in csv.DictReader(stream, delimiter='\t')}
domains, markers, marker_token_counts = {}, {}, {}
for model in MODELS:
    token_counts = Counter()
    for fid, raw in dataset['taxonomies'][model].items():
        tokens = [t.strip() for t in raw.split(';') if t.strip()]
        if not tokens or tokens == ['Unassigned']:
            d = 'unknown'
        else:
            found = [m.group(1).strip() for t in tokens
                     if (m := re.fullmatch(r'(?:d__|D_0__)(.*)', t))]
            assert len(found) == 1 and found[0] in ('Bacteria', 'Archaea', 'Eukaryota'), raw
            d = found[0]
        domains[model, fid] = d
        hits = set()
        for token in tokens:
            match = re.fullmatch(r'(?:[dpcofgs]__|D_[0-6]__)(.*)', token)
            if match and match.group(1).strip().lower() in ('mitochondria', 'chloroplast'):
                hits.add(match.group(1).strip().lower())
                if d == 'Bacteria':
                    token_counts[token] += 1
        markers[model, fid] = hits
    marker_token_counts[model] = dict(token_counts)

rows, summary = [], {}
for model in MODELS:
    bacterial = {fid for fid in dataset['table'] if domains[model, fid] == 'Bacteria'}
    organelles = {fid for fid in bacterial if markers[model, fid]}
    selected = bacterial - organelles
    mito = {fid for fid in bacterial if 'mitochondria' in markers[model, fid]}
    chloro = {fid for fid in bacterial if 'chloroplast' in markers[model, fid]}
    summary[model] = {}
    for label, ids in [('all', set(dataset['table'])),
                       ('soil', {f for f, counts in dataset['table'].items()
                                 if sum(counts[s] for s in dataset['soil_samples']) > 0})]:
        summary[model][label] = dict(Bacteria_before_asv=len(bacterial & ids),
                                    organelle_asv=len(organelles & ids),
                                    selected_asv=len(selected & ids),
                                    mitochondria_asv=len(mito & ids),
                                    chloroplast_asv=len(chloro & ids),
                                    both_markers_asv=len(mito & chloro & ids))
    for sample in dataset['samples']:
        observed = {f for f, counts in dataset['table'].items() if counts[sample] > 0}
        def reads(ids):
            return sum(dataset['table'][fid][sample] for fid in ids)
        total = reads(dataset['table'])
        b = reads(bacterial)
        organelle = reads(organelles)
        remaining = reads(selected)
        row = dict(model=model, sample=sample,
                   sample_type='soil' if sample in dataset['soil_samples'] else 'negative_control',
                   total_retained_reads=total,
                   Bacteria_before_reads=b, Bacteria_before_observed_asv=len(bacterial & observed),
                   organelle_reads=organelle, organelle_observed_asv=len(organelles & observed),
                   mitochondria_reads=reads(mito), chloroplast_reads=reads(chloro),
                   both_markers_reads=reads(mito & chloro),
                   selected_bacterial_reads=remaining, selected_observed_asv=len(selected & observed),
                   excluded_nonbacterial_domain_reads=total - b,
                   excluded_total_reads=total - remaining,
                   selected_fraction_of_original=format(remaining / total, '.17g'),
                   organelle_fraction_of_Bacteria='NA' if not b else format(organelle / b, '.17g'),
                   zero_selected=int(remaining == 0))
        for d in ('Archaea', 'Eukaryota', 'unknown', 'unexpected'):
            ids = {f for f in dataset['table'] if domains[model, f] == d}
            row[d + '_excluded_reads'] = reads(ids)
            row[d + '_excluded_observed_asv'] = len(ids & observed)
            assert reads(ids) == int(old[sample][f'{model}_{d}_reads'])
            assert len(ids & observed) == int(old[sample][f'{model}_{d}_asv'])
        assert total == int(old[sample]['total_retained_reads'])
        assert b == int(old[sample][model + '_Bacteria_reads'])
        assert len(bacterial & observed) == int(old[sample][model + '_Bacteria_asv'])
        assert b == organelle + remaining
        assert total == remaining + organelle + sum(row[d + '_excluded_reads'] for d in ('Archaea', 'Eukaryota', 'unknown', 'unexpected'))
        assert organelle == row['mitochondria_reads'] + row['chloroplast_reads'] - row['both_markers_reads']
        assert len(bacterial & observed) == row['organelle_observed_asv'] + row['selected_observed_asv']
        rows.append(row)
after = {p: sha256(ROOT / p) for p in source_paths}
assert before == after, 'Input changed during audit'
with TSV_OUT.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]), delimiter='\t', lineterminator='\n')
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
nonempty = {model: [r['sample'] for r in rows if r['model'] == model and r['sample_type'] == 'soil' and r['selected_bacterial_reads'] > 0] for model in MODELS}
kr = {model: {r['sample']: r['selected_bacterial_reads'] for r in rows if r['model'] == model and r['sample'].startswith('Kr')} for model in MODELS}
result = dict(author='AI4Science-агент', created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), status='PASS',
              source='Current raw Taxon strings from three QZA taxonomies and integer ASV counts, via read-only load_dataset',
              rule='Per model: keep explicit domain Bacteria, then exclude the union of ASVs with a rank-prefixed token whose entire trimmed value lower() equals mitochondria or chloroplast at ANY rank. No substring or related-taxon inference.',
              overlap_note='mitochondria_reads and chloroplast_reads may overlap; organelle_reads is their union, with both_markers_reads subtracted once.',
              scope='Independent organelle audit only; source QZA, existing audits, article and graph unchanged.',
              command='conda run --no-capture-output -n qiime2-amplicon-2025.7 python3 /tmp/ai4science-organelle-audit-XXXXXXXX.py',
              script_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)), reproduction_python=Path(__file__).read_text(),
              sources_before=before, sources_after=after, inputs_unchanged=True,
              rows=len(rows), checks='All 33 sample/model rows conserve reads and observed bacterial ASVs; all prior domain counts match; no double counting of organelle union.',
              raw_organelle_token_occurrences_in_bacterial_asvs=marker_token_counts,
              asv_summary=summary, selected_Kr_read_counts=kr,
              nonempty_bacterial_soil_samples=nonempty,
              nonempty_soil_n={model: len(values) for model, values in nonempty.items()},
              output={'path': str(TSV_OUT.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': sha256(TSV_OUT)}, violations=[])
with JSON_OUT.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    json.dump(result, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print('PASS: 33 sample/model rows; domain counts matched; union counts conserved; inputs unchanged')
print(json.dumps({'selected_Kr_read_counts': kr, 'nonempty_soil_n': result['nonempty_soil_n'], 'tokens': marker_token_counts}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
checks: All 33 sample/model rows conserve reads and observed bacterial ASVs; all prior domain counts match; no double counting of organelle union.
